goal line=83 text="**Specify the complete API once.** After this design, building the library is an IMPL with phases, not further design."
goal line=85 text="**Every CLI command is one library call plus printing.** The swap PR's `cmd/` diff proves the API is complete, and the parity suite (§4) proves it reproduces v1.2.2 byte for byte. That is how the API is validated: the CLI is the real-world test, and no external consumer is part of it."
goal line=89 text="**Byte cores under every path helper** (ADR-0002 R3), so a no-checkout consumer — the shape tempy and docz-api have — is first-class for mutation as well as reading."
goal line=92 text="**Every built-in type fully specified as a package** — `pkg/impl` with surface, grammar, and identity rules, and `pkg/rfc`, `pkg/adr`, `pkg/design`, `pkg/investigation` with a field per section — each with `Doc` as the root type, over `pkg/doczcore/kinds`."
goal line=96 text="**Typed results everywhere; wording nowhere but `cmd/`** (R4)."
goal line=97 text="**No CLI behaviour change** from the swap (ADR-0001 Decision 7)."
goal line=98 text="**DESIGN-0015 ships in the same unit.** Region markers, the validator, and `docz validate` are part of the API; a release without them is not this API."
goal line=101 text="**Traceable, not tracing.** Context enters at L3 and hooks let a consumer instrument the library; docz imports no telemetry and logs nothing (§7)."
non-goal line=108 text="Typed models for RFC, ADR, DESIGN, or INV. The pattern is fixed (§2.9, §3); each waits for a consumer."
non-goal line=110 text="A runtime type system or a library-defined interface over type packages (R6)."
non-goal line=112 text="Consumer policy in docz: deferred/skipped writers, plan diffs, iteration budgets, gates. `Task.Line` and `Task.EndLine` are the hook; the writers are the consumer's (ADR-0002 Decision 5)."
non-goal line=115 text="New CLI features beyond an optional read-only `docz task list` (ADR-0002 Open Question 4)."
non-goal line=117 text="Changing `.docz.yaml`, the embedded template contents, or the `NNNN-slug.md` filename convention."
non-goal line=119 text="The `updated:` field (DESIGN-0012 / IMPL-0017), which retargets to the release after the swap."
non-goal line=121 text="Telemetry or logging inside the library. The CLI, docz-api, and tempy wire their own over the context and hooks in §7."
